promise_band.headline: You Will Not Be Chasing Us
promise_band.body: Ask any Miami homeowner about landscapers and you will hear the same story: the guy came once, never called back, and the debris is still in the driveway. That is the whole reason we built this business the way we did. You get a call back, a written estimate, a crew on the agreed day, and a property that is cleaner when we leave than when we arrived. Twelve years and 224 verified reviews later, that is still the entire pitch.

signature_system.headline: One Crew, Lawn To Canopy
signature_system.intro: Most properties in Miami-Dade need two things at once — the grass cut on a schedule and the trees kept off the roof. Splitting that between two companies is how homeowners end up with nobody responsible. We do both.

blocks.title: Trained crews, proper equipment, real standards
blocks.body: Tree trimming, palm pruning, canopy reduction and removals are performed by trained, licensed and insured supervised crews working to OSHA safety regulations and ISA standards for pruning. That matters most when the work is happening directly over your roof, your pool cage or your neighbour's car.

blocks.title: We never hatrack your trees
blocks.body: Topping a tree is the fast way to make a canopy smaller and the permanent way to ruin it — Miami-Dade County tells homeowners not to allow it. We thin and reduce properly so the tree keeps its structure and comes back healthy, not as a cluster of weak regrowth waiting for the next storm.

signature_system.steps_title: Clean-up is part of the job, not a second visit

steps.title: Chipper and chip truck on site
steps.body: Branches go through the chipper as we cut, not onto a pile at the curb.

steps.title: Hardscape blown clean
steps.body: Driveway, walkways and pool deck blown off before we pack up.

steps.title: It all leaves with us
steps.body: Debris is hauled the same day. No waiting on a return trip.

guarantee.title: Customer satisfaction, guaranteed
guarantee.body: We start every project with a thorough consultation so we understand your goals and what the property actually needs. Your satisfaction is the priority, and we work to your specifications — including HOA requirements — so the finished job is the one you asked for.

seo_body.headline: Lawn Care And Tree Service In Miami-Dade County
paragraphs: South Florida does not have a growing season — it has twelve months of one. St. Augustine turf keeps running through December, palms drop fronds year-round, and a ficus left alone for two seasons will be into the roofline. A lawn here needs a crew on a schedule, not a spring clean-up.

Then there is June through November. Hurricane season is the reason Miami-Dade County tells homeowners to prune ahead of time rather than wait, and it is why we book canopy thinning early — because once a storm is named, every tree crew in the county is spoken for.

We handle both sides of that: the weekly or bi-weekly maintenance that keeps a property looking right, and the tree work that keeps it safe. Same company, same phone number, one crew that already knows your property.

Residential, commercial and HOA properties across Miami-Dade

faqs.a: Yes. We have all necessary licenses and insurance for all of our projects. Larger construction projects require special licenses and certifications, and we have trusted members of the landscaping community that we work with for those special cases.

faqs.q: Who will work on my landscape?
faqs.a: Our team members have experience and horticultural backgrounds, and we will all be familiar with your unique landscape needs. Tree work is performed by trained, licensed and insured supervised crews working to OSHA safety regulations and ISA pruning standards.

faqs.q: What kind of landscaping do you do?
faqs.a: We can do all kinds of landscaping, but our specialty is in mixing non-native and native plants to make a landscape that meets your needs and fits the ecology of our area.

faqs.q: How often do you cut the grass?
faqs.a: Weekly or bi-weekly — the choice is yours. South Florida grass grows year-round, so most residential properties are on a weekly schedule through the wet season and bi-weekly through the drier months.

faqs.q: Do you take the debris away?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is included. We bring a chipper and a chip truck to tree jobs, so branches are chipped as we cut and hauled off the same day. We also blow your driveway, walkways and pool deck clean before we leave.

faqs.q: When should I have my trees trimmed for hurricane season?
faqs.a: Before it starts. Hurricane season runs June through November in South Florida, and Miami-Dade County advises pruning ahead of it rather than waiting. Once a storm is named, every tree crew in the county is booked — so the useful window is the spring.

faqs.q: Do you work with HOAs and commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with homeowners, commercial property owners and homeowner associations, and we work in accordance with your specifications — including HOA landscaping requirements.

It depends on the size of the property and what the job involves, which is why we come out and look before quoting. The estimate is free, the price is in writing, and our goal is to work within your budget while still doing a superior job.
